name: Mesgedhera

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero better known after his death
made from his brains mixed with lime
king of Ulster struck by the brain ball

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mesgedhera, also Mesgeara, was an Irish hero and warrior. He is known more after his death than in life. His brains were drawn out and mixed with lime. The mix formed a hard round ball. An enemy threw the ball at the king of Ulster, Concobar Mac Nessa. The ball went into the king's head and stayed there. The king lived on years more. The ball killed him when it moved free one day.

okr.objective: Document Mesgedhera and the brain ball that held a king.
